evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we propose PreWoMe, a unified approach capable of handling any type of information-seeking question.
Information-seeking questions in long-form question answering (LFQA) often prove misleading due to ambiguity or false presupposition in the question.

While many existing approaches handle misleading questions, they are tailored to limited questions, which are insufficient in a real-world setting with unpredictable input characteristics.
